attributes.action: Mid term PM’s must gain the mandate of a General Election.
attributes.additional_details: Over the last 10 years the UK has suffered from a conveyor belt of PM’s. To bring stability and prevent the Westminster bubble deciding our leaders, make it mandatory that any change of PM mid term, must be followed by a General Election being called within 180 days of appointment.
attributes.background: Within 180 days of taking office, a mid-term Prime Minister who is put in place by a political party’s process, must call a General Election to obtain a mandate.

rejection.details:
You may wish to sign the following petition, which calls for similar action:

General election now – and always call one if a PM is replaced
